description:
Register the permanent-documentation invariants for audience, placement and tone, so the rewrite of the permanent documentation is reviewed against them.

## Background

The documentation overhaul targets researchers evaluating or adopting gf2, organizes permanent documentation under an adapted Diátaxis layout (`docs/tutorials/`, `docs/how-to/`, `docs/concepts/`, `docs/reference/`), and excludes marketing language. These rules govern permanent-page authoring and are registered alongside that work rather than with the general documentation contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A linked draft proposes one-sentence texts and IDs for the researcher-audience, adapted-Diátaxis-placement and no-marketing invariants.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every invariant text is approved by the user, with the approval recorded as a decision on this issue, before it is registered.
- [hard] REQ-03: The approved invariants are in the registry and the `AGENTS.md` projection region is regenerated deterministically, with content outside the region byte-identical.
- [hard] REQ-04: `jit invariant check`, `jit validate` and the documentation mechanical checks report no new findings.
title: Register audience, placement and tone documentation invariants
